title: IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and IBM Verify Directory 11.0.0 exposes debug endpoints that…
description: IBM Security Verify Directory versions 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and 11.0.0 expose debug endpoints that disclose system information such as server versions and session identifiers. This exposure can aid attackers in identifying vulnerable software versions. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
